findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: surfacedby_inspect_page_evidence · Private data: surfacedby_check_ai_crawler_access · Public sink: surfacedby_check_ai_crawler_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: surfacedby_inspect_page_evidence · Private data: surfacedby_check_ai_crawler_access · Public sink: surfacedby_check_ai_crawler_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
